description: DEF CON Groups presentations and community spotlights showcasing local chapters, technical projects, and hacker community organizing.

talks.title: DC801 Group Spotlight
talks.teaser: Grifter spotlights DC801 in Salt Lake City, Utah, sharing the history of one of the earliest DEF CON local groups and community hackerspace organizing.
talks.summary:
The Origins of DEF CON Groups

DEF CON Groups (DC Groups) were founded to provide local year-round communities for hackers, security enthusiasts, and makers to collaborate, share research, and organize local meetups.

Spotlight on DC801 Salt Lake City

Grifter, one of the co-founders of the DEF CON Groups program, introduces DC801, one of the oldest active local chapters based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

Hackerspace Culture and Local Organizing

The presentation showcases the physical workshop, projects, tool-sharing infrastructure, and community events established by DC801 members.

Empowering Global Local Chapters

Grifter shares lessons in community building, sustainable hackerspace management, and encourages hackers worldwide to start or join local DEF CON Groups.
